metadata.title: Space Apps Challenge 2026 - FieldShift: U.S. EQIP Cover Crop Payment Lookup
metadata.description: All 50 U.S. states with verified FY2026 EQIP Practice 340 standard single-species rates where available and explicitly identified application fallback values elsewhere.
metadata.program: USDA NRCS Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP)
metadata.rounding: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to two decimal places
metadata.fallback_policy: state_rates_usd_ha contains a usable numeric value for every state. Check state_details[state].status: national_fallback means the value is the user-specified 135.0 USD/ha application default, not a verified state EQIP payment.
limitations: The NRCS public payment lookup returned an error loading counties during this search. Published FY2026 documents supplied the verified entries.
Rates describe the selected scenario and standard producer category. They do not establish county-specific contract eligibility or payment guarantees.
All 50 states are included; District of Columbia and U.S. territories are outside this state-only lookup.
